cancelAd(uint256).notice: Owner closes an ad and gets back any remaining locked USDC.

cancelOrder(uint256).notice: Buyer cancels an unpaid order, or anyone cancels it after the payment window; USDC returns to the seller or ad.

confirmPayment(uint256).notice: Seller confirms the fiat arrived; USDC is released to the buyer; status Paid to Completed.

createAd((uint8,string,uint256,uint256,u.notice: Publish an ad; a Sell ad locks its USDC now (approve first).

createOrder(uint256,uint256).notice: Open an order on an ad; the seller's USDC is locked here when taking a Buy ad (approve first).

markPaid(uint256,string).notice: Buyer reports the fiat payment with a reference; status Created to Paid.

openDispute(uint256,string).notice: Buyer or seller disputes a Paid order, with a reason; status Paid to Disputed.

orderIdsOf(address).notice: Order ids where the account is buyer or seller.

sellerStats(address).notice: On-chain seller reputation counters used for the completion rate.
